user.title: Smart Climate Setup
user.description: Configure Smart Climate Controller. You can add more devices afterwards.

data_description.entity_id: The first climate device to control (add more later via the device menu)
data_description.role: Whether this device can heat, cool, or both
data_description.zone_home: The zone entity used for presence detection
data_description.away_temperature: Target temperature when nobody is home (heating)
data_description.cool_auto_temperature: Target temperature when home and the device is cooling
data_description.cool_away_temperature: Target temperature when away and the device is cooling
data_description.away_delay_minutes: Minutes to wait before applying the away temperature
data_description.interruptible: Whether a presence change can interrupt an active override
data_description.default_override_mode: Override mode used when adjusting temperature (timer, infinity, or next_node)
data_description.default_override_duration: Default duration in minutes for timer override mode

data_description.role: Whether this device can heat, cool, or both
data_description.tier: Primary heats alone; a support device (e.g. the CV) only joins when the room is well below the target
data_description.park: What this device does when it is not the one serving the current demand

data_description.tier: Primary heats alone; a support device (e.g. the CV) only joins when the room is well below the target
data_description.park: What this device does when it is not the one serving the current demand

data.support_delta: Support heater joins below target by (°C)
data.support_min_rise: Support joins only below this warming rate (°C/h)

data_description.temperature_source: How the room temperature is measured: mean of devices, a primary device, or a dedicated sensor
data_description.temperature_sensor: Used when the source is 'Dedicated sensor'
data_description.primary_device: Used when the source is 'Primary device'
data_description.hysteresis: Deadband around the switch points to avoid rapid heat/cool flapping
data_description.integration_driven_auto: In auto, let Smart Climate decide heat vs cool (recommended, required for multiple devices)
data_description.weather_entity: Source of the daily forecast; used to decide whether automatic cooling is allowed. Optional
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional measured outdoor temperature; also the fallback when the weather entity is unavailable
data_description.warm_threshold: Auto cooling is allowed when a forecast or measured outdoor high (last 24 h) reaches this value
data_description.hard_ceiling: Auto cooling is always allowed when the room is at or above this temperature
data_description.support_delta: The support heater joins when the room is this far below the heat target, and leaves again below half of it
data_description.support_grace: How long the primary heater gets to close the gap before the support heater may join (0 = join immediately)
data_description.support_min_rise: The support heater only joins when the room warms slower than this. A steady warm-up (e.g. after arriving home) does not need support
